name: ghana-drilling-estimate
description: Estimate borehole drilling cost and timeline for Ghana regions using GBDA benchmarks
steps:
1. Confirm region, target depth, formation difficulty, and pump requirement.
2. Run calculate_drilling_cost with depth_m and region from pack knowledge.
3. Present cost breakdown: drilling, rig hire, crew, materials.
4. State data_as_of (GBDA 2022 benchmarks) and recommend formal written quote.
5. Flag if site access or mobilisation may add cost beyond table rates.

name: water-quality-limits
description: Check water sample results against Ghana Standards Authority and WHO drinking water limits
steps:
1. Collect parameter names and measured values from user or lab PDF.
2. Compare against limits in corpus/05-water-quality-standards.md.
3. Flag exceedances with health significance (iron, manganese, fluoride, E. coli).
4. Suggest retest or treatment; not a substitute for certified lab sign-off.

name: project-tracking
description: Track active borehole projects, depth progress, and submit drilling logs via ABBIS
steps:
1. Use ABBIS API tools when available: list boreholes, get project detail.
2. For log submission: confirm project_id, depth_start_m, depth_end_m, formation, fluid returns.
3. Summarise depth progress vs target and days on site.
4. Alert rig owner if no log received for an active drilling project.

name: fleet-management
description: Rig status, maintenance schedules, and equipment fault reporting
steps:
1. List rigs by status when ABBIS fleet API is available.
2. For faults: capture rig_id, severity (minor/moderate/critical), description, project_id.
3. Critical faults: advise stop drilling until inspected.
4. Reference equipment makes from corpus/08-equipment-registry.md when relevant.

name: financial-invoicing
description: Invoices, outstanding payments, and project P&L for rig owners
steps:
1. List invoices by status when ABBIS billing API is available.
2. Summarise aging: 0-30, 31-60, 60+ days overdue.
3. Link invoice lines to borehole project milestones where possible.
4. Do not initiate Paystack payments without user confirmation.

name: cwsa-compliance
description: CWSA completion reports, siting rules, and compliance deadlines
steps:
1. Apply CWSA siting rules from corpus/06-cwsa-standards.md (150m from latrine, etc.).
2. Generate completion report via API when project is marked complete.
3. Verify pump test and water quality records attached before certification.
4. Flag missing EPA permit where applicable.

name: marketplace-vendor
description: Search marketplace products and vendor profiles for drilling materials
steps:
1. Search products by category and region when marketplace API is available.
2. Compare lead times and delivery radius for mobilising projects.
3. For vendors: summarise order backlog and review scores.
4. Recommend GBDA-member vendors when trust signal matters.

name: drilling-calculators
description: Pump sizing, casing design, bentonite volumes, and pump test yield analysis
steps:
1. Pump selection: use calculate_pump_selection with yield, TDH, power supply.
2. Casing: use calculate_casing_design with aquifer top/bottom and static water level.
3. Fluids: calculate_bentonite_volume for hole diameter and depth.
4. Gravel pack: calculate_gravel_pack_volume for screen length.
5. Pump test: calculate_yield_from_pump_test for specific capacity estimate.
